selection_policy: Run tiers in listed order. A seed-1 pilot may start replication, but a tier is selected only after the cross-seed mechanism gate passes. Do not inspect FCT or queue direction until selection is complete.

cross_seed_replication_gate.phase_1: Run all five IRN seeds first. Every seed must complete all flows, produce IRN NACKs and retransmissions, and report zero timeout recoveries.
cross_seed_replication_gate.phase_2: Only after phase 1 passes, run the same five flow hashes with PFC on and IRN off. Every seed must complete all flows and produce matched PFC intervals with no unmatched events.
cross_seed_replication_gate.failure_action: Record the failed tier without performance, then advance to the next already-frozen tier. Never change a tier or choose by performance direction.

comparison_semantics.pfc: PFC-on, IRN-off; PFC pause is congestion control, while ordinary go-back recovery may still repair packet errors.
comparison_semantics.irn: PFC-off, IRN-on; IRN NACK/SACK and retransmission repair congestion or injected packet loss.
comparison_semantics.error_rule: Both arms of a tier use the identical ERROR_RATE_PER_LINK. PFC counters and IRN counters are reported separately; injected errors are never described as congestion.
